public_rationale: Seeking wealthy individuals does not by itself establish that institutional funding is exhausted. CNBC reports institutional participation and an unfinished financing process, but that does not prove additional institutional willingness either. The categorical claim is not settled by the accessible evidence.
limitations: Private investor intentions are incompletely observable.
The original WSJ and FT reports could not be read with read_page; accessible reporting is used instead.
Later commitments would need evidence tying the underlying willingness to the target period.

criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous investor statements, fundraising records or well-sourced reporting establish that the named investor groups had exhausted their willingness to supply additional financing on the terms then being offered.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes additional willingness from a named investor group beyond the commitments the speaker describes, during the target period.

evidence.explanation: The report describes institutional participation and a round that remained open. It does not establish whether those investors would supply more than their existing commitments, or whether all three investor groups had reached their limits.
